faq.q: जानकारी के लिए कहां संपर्क करें?

hi.body:
## क्या हुआ है

National Testing Agency (NTA) ने RIMC Entrance Examination 2026 के लिए एक सूचना जारी की है। यह परीक्षा Ministry of Defence की ओर से 6 दिसंबर 2026, रविवार को होगी। सूचना में परीक्षा के समय, centre में entry और खाने-पीने से जुड़ी हिदायतें दी गई हैं।

## किसे ध्यान रखना है

जो उम्मीदवार यह परीक्षा दे रहे हैं, उन सबको। सूचना में यह भी कहा गया है कि अभिभावक और guardian भी इन बातों को पढ़ लें, ताकि परीक्षा के दिन कोई परेशानी न हो।

## centre में entry का समय

centre में entry सुबह 8:00 बजे से 9:30 बजे तक ही होगी। सूचना के मुताबिक 9:30 बजे के बाद किसी भी हालत में entry नहीं मिलेगी। इसलिए घर से समय निकालकर चलें।

## परीक्षा कैसे होगी

परीक्षा एक ही दिन तीन shifts में होगी। English, Mathematics और General Knowledge के पेपर होंगे। Mathematics और General Knowledge के बीच 5 मिनट का छोटा break है, जिसमें washroom जा सकते हैं, लेकिन अगला पेपर शुरू होने से पहले अपनी सीट पर लौटना होगा।

## खाने का क्या करें

अपना सूखा खाना जैसे सैंडविच, पराठा, फल आदि टिफ़िन में लेकर जाएं। टिफ़िन पर अपना नाम और application number साफ़ लिखें। टिफ़िन परीक्षा कक्ष में invigilator के बताए स्थान पर रखा जाएगा।

lunch break 45 मिनट का है। इस दौरान centre के अंदर ही तय जगह पर खाना खा सकते हैं। 2:45 बजे तक अपनी सीट पर लौटना ज़रूरी है।

## बाहर नहीं जा सकते

centre में घुसने और security check होने के बाद पूरी परीक्षा खत्म होने तक बाहर नहीं जा सकते। इसलिए परीक्षा के दिन के लिए अपनी यात्रा और इंतज़ाम पहले से सोच लें।

## मदद कहां मिलेगी

किसी भी सवाल के लिए NTA helpdesk पर फोन कर सकते हैं या rimc@nta.gov.in पर ईमेल भेज सकते हैं। परीक्षा से जुड़े नए updates के लिए NTA की वेबसाइट और RIMCEE की exam वेबसाइट देखते रहें। अपने admit card पर लिखे reporting time और हिदायतों को भी ध्यान से पढ़ें।

en.title: RIMC Entrance Exam on 6 December: no entry after 9:30 AM, carry your own tiffin
en.summary: NTA has issued instructions for the RIMC Entrance Examination to be held on 6 December 2026. The exam will run in three shifts and entry to the centre will be allowed only from 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM.
en.searchTitle: RIMC Entrance Exam 6 December: entry till 9:30 AM
en.searchDescription: Three shifts, a 45-minute lunch break. Carry dry food in a tiffin box marked with your name and application number.
en.meaning: This matters to candidates appearing for the RIMC Entrance Examination. No one will be allowed into the centre after 9:30 AM, so reach well in time. You must stay inside the centre all day, so carry dry food in a tiffin box marked with your name and application number.
keyFacts: Entry to centre from 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM
Lunch break of 45 minutes, 2:00 PM to 2:45 PM
Candidates must be back on their seats by 2:45 PM
No leaving the centre until the entire exam is over

faq.q: Till what time is entry allowed for the RIMC Entrance Exam?
faq.a: Till 9:30 AM. No candidate will be allowed to enter after that under any circumstances.

faq.q: Do I need to bring food with me?
faq.a: Yes, carry your own dry food such as sandwiches, parathas and fruits in a tiffin box. Write your name and application number clearly on the box.

faq.q: Can I leave the centre between papers?
faq.a: No. Once you enter the centre, you cannot leave until the entire examination is over. During the lunch break you can eat at a designated place inside the centre.

faq.q: How many shifts will the exam have?
faq.a: Three shifts, with papers in English, Mathematics and General Knowledge.

faq.q: Where can I get help or clarifications?
faq.a: Contact the NTA helpdesk or email rimc@nta.gov.in. Updates are also posted on the NTA website.

en.body:
## What has been issued

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has issued an advisory for the RIMC Entrance Examination 2026, which it is conducting on behalf of the Ministry of Defence. The exam is scheduled for Sunday, 6 December 2026. The advisory sets out the exam schedule, entry arrangements and instructions for the day.

## Who needs to follow it

All candidates appearing for the examination. The notice also asks parents and guardians to read the instructions and plan travel and exam-day arrangements in advance.

## Entry to the centre

Entry into the examination centre will be allowed from 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM. According to the notice, entry closes strictly at 9:30 AM and no candidate will be allowed in after that under any circumstances.

## How the exam will run

The examination will be held in three consecutive shifts on the same day, with papers in English, Mathematics and General Knowledge. There is a short 5-minute break between the Mathematics and General Knowledge papers, during which candidates may use the washroom, but they must return to their seats before the next paper begins.

## Food and the lunch break

Candidates should bring their own dry food such as sandwiches, parathas and fruits, packed in a tiffin box clearly marked with their name and application number. The tiffin boxes will be kept at a designated place in the examination room as directed by the invigilator.

The lunch break is 45 minutes long. Candidates may eat at a designated location inside the centre, and must be back on their allotted seats by 2:45 PM.

## You cannot leave the centre

Once a candidate has entered the premises and completed the security checks, they cannot leave until the entire examination is over. Plan the day accordingly.

## Where to get help

For clarifications, candidates can contact the NTA helpdesk or email rimc@nta.gov.in. They should also check the NTA website and the RIMCEE exam website for updates, and follow the reporting time and instructions printed on their admit cards.
